items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Then they had a woman who was playing piano. She's a school teacher right now. Her name is Ruby.

ctx.x: Charlie Love. Yeah, Charlie Love was playing second trumpet in my band. I was playing first trumpet. See? Then they had a woman who was playing piano. She's a school teacher right now. Her name is Ruby. I forgot her last name. That's all I remember. And Joe Howell was playing sousaphone. And I can't call this guy. This is one of them old Cajuns from down the country was playing banjo. Leo Sanji. Yeah, I don't remember. You don't remember him. Yeah, well, he died. Well, he was playing banjo in the band. He was…
Oh, yeah. Yeah. Yeah. All right.
